title: Price list body
description: What every institution service costs and how each price is split (credits.md 4.1, CR-5, register row DK2). Signed by the Treasury; a chain (prev is the list before; null for version 1). The envelope's issued_at is the time of issue. Credits are accounting entries, not money.

effective_from.description: When the list applies; never earlier than issued_at, and with notice for a price rise or split change (72 hours) or a fall (24 hours).

bounds_version.description: The version of the split bounds the list is checked against (1 is credits.md section 3).

job_tax_permille.description: The settlement tax (credits.md NS2). Carried and range-checked; not yet applied to settlements (CR-15).

effect.description: A catalogue item's stated effect (shops.md 3). `type` is checked by the log against an allowlist (effect_not_allowed); a `target` or type that names standing (tier, rank, certificate, bond floor, Mandate scope, eligibility) is refused (effect_touches_standing); a resource effect needs `resource`, `amount`, `cap_per_sponsor` and `unit_cost_ref` and a duration (resource_effect_uncapped).

duration_days.description: How long a purchase of this item lasts: 1 for the daily upkeep, 30 for a resource, 90 for a display item.

gate.description: What the buyer needs: a tier at or above `min_tier`, and a valid certificate in `certificate` (a skill, or * for any).

gives_standing.description: True for an item that gives standing (a certificate, a rank, a badge): such an item is refused as self-dealing when a payee is the buyer, the buyer's sponsor, or controlled by the buyer's sponsor (credits.md 5.2 R9).
